research.h: 1. Share of voice: Malabar outspends everyone and is still accelerating
p: Malabar has 1,051 Meta ads (40% of all 2,623 in the set) and 9,922 Google ads. Its new Google creatives went from ~970/month in Jul–Aug to 1,879 in Sep and 2,235 in Oct. It is still scaling into the festive season.

Volume tiers: Malabar is in a league of its own. GRT (469 Meta, 1,828 Google) and Thangamayil (393 Meta, 1,916 Google) form a second tier. Bhima Gold is big on Google search only (6,211 ads, mostly search). Kalyan, Joy, Jos and Khazana are mid-weight, and Lalitha is almost absent (8 Meta, 10 Google).
Malabar's median Meta ad runs only 4 days, and 627 of its ads reuse a creative across several ads (up to 58). That pattern means always-on catalogue rotation, not campaign bursts.

research.h: 2. Targeting: brands split campaigns by state, language and store
p: UTM tags in the landing URLs show the targeting set-up. GRT runs GRT_Diwali_AP / _TN / _HYD / _BLR / _PY plus a store-launch campaign (GRT_Pudukottai_Showroom_Launch). Khazana runs diwali_2026_{ig|fb}_reach_{tn|ts|ap|ka}, a reach campaign per state per platform. Joy Alukkas (Havas) runs HM_<state>_market for 13 states, including HM_TN_PY_market and HM_APTS_market.

The language version follows the state campaign. The same film is dubbed into Tamil, Telugu and Kannada and sent to each state's campaign. That is why most 'regional' ads are dubs: the targeting is regional, but the creative is not.

Google search is city-led. Bhima Gold runs 3,705 search ads, mostly 'today's gold rate per gram / lowest price' with a city name: Vijayawada (612 ads), Bengaluru (608), Hosur (328), Chennai (327), Rajahmundry (323). It is the only brand buying gold-rate searches at city level in AP and TN.
Maps/local store ads: Malabar (191 locations), Joy (129), Jos (111) and GRT (111) promote individual showrooms on Google Maps. Thangamayil and Lalitha barely use local store ads.

research.h: 3. Messaging: five crowded territories and two open ones
p: Meta themes across all brands: Discount/Sale leads (1,537 ads), then Diamond, Silver, Gold rate/purity, Making-charges offers, Savings schemes and Gold exchange.

Brand ownership: Malabar owns Diamond (852 of its 1,051 ads) and lightweight daily wear. GRT owns Silver (289) and Gold exchange (125). Joy and Kalyan own Savings schemes (99 and 112) and gold-rate protection. Khazana owns Making-charges discounts (112 of 120). Thangamayil is pure Discount plus Silver.

Open territory 1, liquidity: Joy Alukkas is the only brand running 'Don't get trapped by high-interest loans, sell your gold' (image ads running 61+ days, plus Telugu films). Kalyan touches gold loans in 25 ads. Nobody else talks about gold as money in a crisis.
Open territory 2, price transparency: only Lalitha says 'compare our estimate slip, buy wherever it is cheaper'. One Tamil film reached 52M views on YouTube with almost no other media behind it.

research.h: 4. Offer depth: how much each brand gives away
p: Median stated offer in Meta copy: Joy Alukkas 50% (flat 50% off making charges, 62 ads), Bhima 45%, Malabar 30%, Jos and Khazana 25%, GRT, Kalyan and Thangamayil 20%. These are discounts on making charges or wastage, never on the gold price itself.
GRT uses the most promo-led copy (224 ads state an offer %), and is the only brand pushing coupon-style 'CODES/OFFERS' on Meta.
Offers are always tied to a deadline ('till 8 Nov', 'valid upto Feb 28'). Thangamayil puts a date window in almost every ad title.

research.h: 5. Festival calendar: Diwali for everyone, regional festivals for the winners
p: Meta festival tags: Diwali/Dhanteras 804 ads, Wedding 302, Akshaya Tritiya 40, Ganesh Chaturthi 14. Diwali is about 69% of all festival-tags.

On YouTube, GRT, Thangamayil and Bhima build named regional-festival campaigns: Pon Pongal, Swarna Ugadi, Swarna Sankranti, Aadi Thanga Thiruvizha, Aadi Perukku, Varamahalakshmi, Vasantha Panchami, Thai and Subha Muhurtham. Malabar, Kalyan and Joy mostly run pan-India festivals.
Wedding is the second calendar: Kalyan tags 115 of 199 ads Wedding, Thangamayil 65 and Malabar 47.

research.h: 6. Formats and longevity: catalogue automation vs evergreen video
p: Dynamic catalogue (DCO) ads dominate the big spenders: Malabar 575, GRT 189, Kalyan 169, Jos 82. These are product feeds, not crafted regional creative.

Evergreen winners (ads still running after months): GRT 'Gold Earrings' DCO (377 days), Bhima 'A masterpiece of tradition' video (298 days), Thangamayil 'Shop from the comfort of home' video (219 days), Kalyan '4-Level Assurance' video (159 days). Kalyan's median ad has run 104 days, so it runs fewer ads for much longer.
Thangamayil is video-first (209 video plus 75 creator-partnership video out of 393) and is the only brand where creator partnership is a main Meta ad format (76 ads).

research.h: 7. CTA and funnel: the showroom is the conversion point
p: Across all Meta ads: Learn More 1,355, Shop Now 526, See Details 187, Get Quote 134, Book Now 122, Apply Now 64. Two thirds of CTAs are soft.

Funnel types: (a) lead-gen to Messenger or instant forms (Kalyan 90% to Facebook/Messenger with 'Book Now'; Joy 48% with 'Get Quote'); (b) store visit via store locator (Khazana 57%) or Instagram (Thangamayil 37%, Khazana 40%); (c) e-commerce product pages (GRT 46%, Malabar 38% PDP plus 46% collection pages); (d) savings-scheme sign-up (Lalitha, Bhima Smart Gold app).
Nobody runs a WhatsApp or click-to-call regional funnel at scale ('Call Now' appears on only 31 ads). In Tier 2/3 Tamil Nadu and AP that is a clear gap.

research.h: 8. Creators: boosting is common, and organic creators earn better engagement
p: 298 creator collab posts with 215 unique creators across 9 brands. Each post was benchmarked against that creator's own last 10 reels.

Likely-boosted posts: median 2.46M views but only a 0.18% like rate. Organic posts: 168K views at a 1.62% like rate. 'Organic outperformance' posts (high views and a high like rate): 968K views at 3.9%. Boosting buys reach, not engagement.

Thangamayil boosts hardest: 29 of 57 posts likely boosted and 399M total views, the most of any brand, from mid-size Tamil creators (median 352K followers) and actress Sneha (56M). Bhima boosts 41 of 76 but mostly in Malayalam and English. GRT has the broadest roster (46 creators in Tamil, Telugu and Kannada).

Celebrity versus creator: Joy Alukkas' reach comes almost entirely from three celebrity collabs (Samantha and Kajol, 34–57M each). Co-authored posts appear once per co-author, so the brand's row total double-counts them. Kalyan's creators are film-promotion tie-ins. Khazana and Lalitha use only 4 creators each, all organic.

In-house on Google: Malabar (Malabar Gold Ltd plus Malabar Investments PLC), Thangamayil, Khazana, Lalitha and Bhima Gold. Agency-run: Jos Alukkas (Dentsu, 99%), Kalyan (Matrix), Joy Alukkas (Havas, Matrix, BMEG), GRT (MbF, WPP, Schbang, Diginfluenz).

Schbang Digital Solutions is the paying advertiser on 322 GRT Google ads (36 live). One GRT Meta UTM is 'sch_grt_meta_diamondcollection_sales_june26_ASC_SL'. GRT therefore splits its media across at least four agencies, and Schbang already has a seat.

Write Telugu natively. AP/TS has no Thangamayil-style native brand. Take Telugu-first scripts with Telugu creators into Ashadam, Sravana Masam, Ugadi and Sankranti, with a rupee offer in the first 3 seconds.
Use state- and store-level campaigns as the default: per-state campaigns (as GRT and Khazana do), plus 'happy news for <town>' store-launch films with a local face (as Kalyan does).
Choose organic-performing regional creators over boosting big names. Benchmark every collab against the creator's own baseline, and only boost posts whose like rate holds up.
Take an open territory: gold liquidity ('sell, don't pledge') or price transparency (estimate-slip comparison). Both work and only one brand owns each.
Move the funnel to WhatsApp, click-to-call and store locator for Tier 2/3, and pair Meta with city-level Google gold-rate search (the Bhima Gold model).
